comments.author: Robin_2025
comments.body:
\*\*The 10 rules\*\*

1. \*\*Only big companies in the right sectors.\*\* Market value $10 billion or more, and not consumer, healthcare, or real estate. This one filter takes the odds from 34% to 47%.

2. \*\*Buy only what's already moving or already agreed on.\*\* The stock is up 30%+ since the manager bought it, or 4+ of the 138 managers opened it the same quarter. Don't wait for a dip — the ones that haven't moved yet do worse.

3. \*\*Skip tiny lines and fresh misses.\*\* The position should be at least 1% of the manager's book, and if the last earnings report before the filing dropped the stock 10%+, pass.

4. \*\*Buy the whole quarterly list, equal weight, ten names minimum.\*\* One pick is a coin flip. The full list beat the index in 11 of 15 quarters, and 10% of the names made 59% of the money — you cannot tell which ones in advance.

5. \*\*Hold 12 months. No stop-loss, no profit target.\*\* Every exit rule lowered the return. The edge builds all year: +4% over the index at 3 months, +18% at 12.

6. \*\*Down 10% is normal. Down 20% is a warning.\*\* Half of the eventual winners were down 10% first. Of positions that fell 20%, four in five never caught the index — so don't add money to those, but don't panic-sell the basket either.

7. \*\*Never average down.\*\* Even the pros' adds below their own cost beat the index only 37% of the time; their adds to winners, 45%. If you add at all, add to what's working.

8. \*\*Ignore who's buying or selling.\*\* The manager's name, fame, record, and category predict nothing. Insider buying predicts nothing. And a manager's exit is not a sell signal — the stock did the same after his sale as after his purchase.

9. \*\*Don't trade around earnings.\*\* One report in four moves the stock 10%+, direction unknowable in advance. After the move there is no reliable bounce and no reliable further collapse — the news is in the price. Hold through it.

10. \*\*Expect to beat the index about 55% of the time, and expect 1 in 5 trades to lose 25%+ against it.\*\* Judge the method after 30 trades and 12 months, not 3 trades and 3 weeks. Log every trade.

The next list arrives with the Q3 filings, due Monday, November 16.
